scenario.task:
I want to transfer my daughter's phone number from her current provider to my Bell family plan

User Guide: The user wants to add a line by porting a number. They will verify their identity, provide the external number and account details, and complete the transfer request If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
